archetype: 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) for B2B, 1 (Organic & Earthy) for B2C
design_philosophy: Editorial, dense, monospace overlines, tabular numerals, asymmetric grids, sharp 4px radius corners, lots of negative space, 'Filevine-killer' tone.

shared_components_to_create.name: MockBrowserChrome
shared_components_to_create.description: A reusable wrapper that looks like a clean, minimal Safari/Chrome window. Dark mode or light mode support.

shared_components_to_create.name: AnnotationPin
shared_components_to_create.description: An absolute positioned callout pin with a pulsing dot and an animated line connecting to a label, pointing out key features in the mockup.

shared_components_to_create.name: StatusPip
shared_components_to_create.description: A small pill-shaped component displaying a status, using monospace text and contextual colors (e.g., green for 'Settled', amber for 'Pending').

shared_components_to_create.name: AvatarGroup
shared_components_to_create.description: Overlapping user avatars to show collaboration.

tailwind_patterns.overline: text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-praxium-subtle font-semibold
tailwind_patterns.btn_praxium: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-praxium-accent text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-sm font-display font-bold tracking-wide text-sm uppercase transition-colors hover:bg-praxium-accent-hover

micro_interactions.hover_states: Subtle -translate-y-0.5, border color darkens, shadow increases.
micro_interactions.scroll_triggered: Fade-in with slight translate-y on scroll (use framer-motion or simple intersection observer).
micro_interactions.marquee: Use for continuous stream of background integrations or docket feeds.
micro_interactions.pulsing: Use for live AI typing indicators and active call statuses.

b2b_product_showcases.title: The Matter Canvas
b2b_product_showcases.narrative: Run every matter from one canvas.
b2b_product_showcases.placement: Landing.jsx, replacing the generic 'PILLARS' block for the Practice tab.
b2b_product_showcases.layout_spec: Asymmetric bento grid inside a MockBrowserChrome. Left side: 3/4 width showing the matter details. Right side: 1/4 width showing the CoCounsel Sidebar.
b2b_product_showcases.mockup_composition: Header with case number (Smith v. Acme - M-2026-0034) and StatusPip (Discovery). A dense data grid showing Incident Date, SOL Date (highlighted in red), Value Est. Tabs (Overview, Tasks, Documents). A timeline view showing recent actor activity.

b2b_product_showcases.title: Glass-box AI
b2b_product_showcases.narrative: The AI that actually ships work.
b2b_product_showcases.placement: Landing.jsx, inside the CoCounsel AI section.
b2b_product_showcases.layout_spec: Floating glassmorphism panel overlapping a blurred document in the background.
b2b_product_showcases.mockup_composition: Chat interface. User prompt: 'Draft a demand letter for Smith based on Dr. Patel's chron.' AI response streaming. Includes citation pills like [Dr. Patel Chron p.4] that hover to show actual text.

dummy_data.prompt: Draft demand for Smith citing the L5-S1 herniation.
dummy_data.ai_response: Here is a draft demand letter highlighting the L5-S1 disc herniation diagnosed by Dr. Patel. I have calculated the specials at $42,500 based on the attached billing records.

b2b_product_showcases.title: Keyboard-first ⌘K
b2b_product_showcases.narrative: Find any matter without touching the mouse.
b2b_product_showcases.layout_spec: Center-aligned floating search modal with rich results.
b2b_product_showcases.mockup_composition: Search input with 'sm...' typed. Results broken down by 'Matters', 'Actions', 'Contacts'. Highlighting the arrow keys navigation state.

b2b_product_showcases.title: VoxLine Call Console
b2b_product_showcases.layout_spec: Dark mode panel (terminal aesthetic) to contrast with the light theme, representing the live call dialer.
b2b_product_showcases.mockup_composition: Active call duration (04:12). Live scrolling transcript. Right side panel: AI live extracting action items (e.g., 'Schedule IME').

b2b_product_showcases.title: MedConnect Inbox
b2b_product_showcases.mockup_composition: Table listing providers, status pips (Requested, Received, Needs Follow-up), cost, and AI MedChron status.

b2c_product_showcases.title: Doctor Network
b2c_product_showcases.layout_spec: Card-based mobile view showing a map stub and a list of doctors.
b2c_product_showcases.mockup_composition: Doctor profiles with 'Accepts LOP' badges, distance, and 'Book next Tuesday' buttons.

horizontal_tour_section.placement: Landing.jsx, just above the Pricing section.
horizontal_tour_section.title: The Matter Lifecycle
horizontal_tour_section.description: A horizontally scrolling flex container (hide scrollbar) showing 4 stages of a matter. Each stage is a distinct card mimicking the UI at that point.

live_demo_strip.placement: Landing.jsx, Hero section right side or bottom.
